statement: Graphics preset revision 4 enables the render-only, budgeted near-terrain refinement for new High and Ultra selections; Low and Medium keep it off. Saved revisions 1-3 and explicit saved overrides keep their payloads until the player reselects a preset. Refinement stays within the existing 4 MiB, 8-upload and 3 ms per-frame budget and defers past its deadline. Native High/Ultra p99 at or below 8.33 ms is qualified in the release native pass. Added render vertices preserve all five interpolated natural-ground coverage lanes independently of the flat diagnostic ID; ordinary live and distant vertices retain one-hot coverage. Packed render words are refused as refinement input. The existing 1024-pixel terrain arrays and two-scale sand sampling, material transitions and WorldVisualSweep texture-detail checks for issue #872 remain pending native re-capture.

evidence.planned: Qualify native High/Ultra p99 at or below 8.33 ms with refinement on in the release native pass; owner: rendering
